input.title: Fix login crash
input.description: Fixed a crash on login screen when user enters empty password.

judge.prompt: Score 1.0 if the output follows EXACTLY this format: '[Title]- [Single sentence ending with period]'. Score 0.5 if close but has extra HTML tags or missing elements. Score 0.0 if completely wrong format.

input.title: Fix export button alignment
input.description: Corrected the alignment of the export button on the reports page.

judge.prompt: Score 1.0 if the release note ends with 'for some systems' (required for non-global bugs). Score 0.0 if this phrase is missing.

input.title: Fix dashboard loading error
input.description: Fixed an error that prevented the dashboard from loading.

judge.prompt: Score 1.0 if the release note does NOT contain 'for some systems' (global bugs affect everyone). Score 0.0 if it incorrectly includes this phrase. Also verify it's clear and professional.

input.title: WB - Fix shape resize handles
input.description: Fixed an issue where shape resize handles were not appearing correctly.

judge.prompt: Score 1.0 if: (1) 'WB' is expanded to 'Whiteboard', (2) does NOT say 'for some systems' (whiteboard items are exempt), (3) is clear and professional. Deduct 0.3 for each violation.

input.title: VI 3 - Dropdown not closing
input.description: Fixed dropdown menu not closing when clicking outside in View Idea 3.

judge.prompt: Score 1.0 if 'VI' is expanded to 'View Idea'. Score 0.0 if 'VI' appears unexpanded in the output.

input.title: Add dark mode
input.description: Implemented dark mode for better user experience at night.

judge.prompt: Evaluate: (1) Written for non-technical users, (2) Clearly states the new capability, (3) Professional tone.

input.title: Add email notifications
input.description: Users can now receive email notifications when their reports are ready.

judge.prompt: Score 1.0 if the release note clearly explains the USER BENEFIT (not just the technical change). Should answer 'what can I do now?'. Score 0.5 if technically correct but not user-focused.

input.title: Performance improvement in search
input.description: Optimized database queries to improve search performance by 50%.

judge.prompt: Score 1.0 if: (1) Communicates user benefit (faster search), (2) Avoids technical jargon like 'database queries' or 'optimized', (3) Clear and concise. Score 0.5 if benefit is clear but has jargon.

input.title: Security patch for authentication
input.description: Applied security updates to the authentication system to fix CVE-2024-1234 vulnerability.

judge.prompt: Score 1.0 if: (1) Does NOT mention specific vulnerability details (CVE numbers, exploit methods), (2) Still conveys that security was improved, (3) Professional. Score 0.0 if it exposes security details.

input.title: Fix issue reported by Acme Corp
input.description: Fixed the export bug that John Smith from Acme Corporation reported last week.

judge.prompt: Score 1.0 if NO names (personal or business) appear in the output. Score 0.0 if 'John', 'Smith', 'Acme', or any other name appears.

input.title: Refactor API endpoint validation
input.description: Refactored the REST API endpoint validation middleware to use JSON schema validation instead of manual checks.

judge.prompt: Score 1.0 if a non-technical person could understand the release note. Should NOT contain: 'API', 'endpoint', 'middleware', 'JSON schema', 'refactor'. Score 0.5 if mostly plain but has 1-2 technical terms.

input.title: Update API docs
input.description: Updated the API documentation to reflect recent changes.

judge.prompt: Score 1.0 if the note clearly states what documentation was updated and why users should care. Score 0.5 if it just says 'documentation updated' without context.

input.title: Hackathon submission form validation
input.description: Added client-side validation to the hackathon submission form.

judge.prompt: Score 1.0 if: (1) Mentions Hackathon feature area, (2) Explains the improvement in user terms, (3) Avoids 'client-side validation' jargon.

input.title: Project Room - Fix member invite flow
input.description: Fixed an issue where invited members were not receiving their invitation emails.

judge.prompt: Score 1.0 if: (1) Mentions 'Project Room', (2) Clearly states what was fixed from user perspective, (3) Professional tone.
Score 1.0 if the release note is still coherent and professional despite having no description to work with. Should not mention that description was missing.
